Files copied:
  - stb_image_write.h    (single-header C library; #define
                          STB_IMAGE_WRITE_IMPLEMENTATION in exactly
                          one translation unit to instantiate the
                          implementation — done in
                          src/image_diff/png_writer.nim via {.emit.})
  - LICENSE              (dual public-domain / MIT)

Used by src/image_diff/png_writer.nim to render the FLIP error map as
a colour-mapped PNG for human inspection. We picked stb_image_write
over libpng+pkg-config because (1) it has no runtime dependency,
(2) it is tiny (~70 KB single header), and (3) the rest of the
CodeTracer toolchain already uses similar single-header C libraries
(for example the QOI codec used elsewhere in the CodeTracer
toolchain).
